I think Everyone at Sploot Veterinary Care is Wonderful. Soooooooooo nice and talks to you later a person and answers all your questions...
I have found me a NEW VETERINARY DOCTORS  !!!!!!

THANK YOU AGAIN

I have a rescue and have told them multiple times that my puppy is getting spayed elsewhere and they still had us come in for a pre-spay check up. You got me in quick. My cat seemed satisfied as well.
Everyone was friendly. Great vet techs. The doctor was caring and reassuring. My cat did well. They took care of her very well.
Thank you for the 5-star love, Jenn! We’re so glad your Sploot vet care experience was a great one.💛 …

Worth the cost in my opinion. Staff have always been kind and knowledgeable. They always explain what’s going on and offer multiple options if you need to space out/reduce costs. I also have never felt pressured to get something that wasn’t necessary. If you have a pet who needs dental work, the membership (optional!) more than pays for itself, and everyone at the Roscoe location is especially knowledgeable about those issues.
Always so kind and gives us the best care for our 3 cats!
Thank you for the 5 stars, Sherry! We appreciate your trust in Sploot and are always here whenever you need us!💛 …
We’re taken early, everyone was very professional and efficient. Everything was explained to us and all our questions were answered. Highly recommended.
Quick friendly service. My dog loves their employees
So nice, quick, and my puppy who is normally anxious at the vet was very calm because the environment was so nice.
Thank you, Taba and Dr. Rincon for getting Fergus’s ear infection sorted out!

I cannot say enough good things about Sploot Roscoe Village. During a very stressful day, the staff made it incredibly easy to book and got my dog, Sasha, in very quickly. Taba C. and Dr. Perkins immediately performed the necessary tests and went above and beyond to handle my scared Sasha with so much tenderness and care. They were both so pleasant, patient, and informative through the entire process, giving me answers and peace of mind when I needed it most. Highly recommend this wonderful team!

Great first visit for my son's cat. They suggested shots that are required and even recommended other places that could be cheaper rather forcing us to get the shots at Sploot. We will certainly continue coming here.
always so kind and respectful!

If you're looking for just getting your pets checkups its ok at average pricing But if you're looking to have a consistent veterinarian attend to your pet this is definitely not the place to go.  In the 2yrs I went there i never seen the same Vet twice.  They'll tell you that they're all qualified  and they are but they also all play catch-up  to the previous vets notes which results in things missed, or wrong test given due to a enormous lack of communication between all parties which was my experience. So if you care about your pet I recommend avoiding the big box store veterinary clinics and go to were your pet is treated like an individual and not like just another billing invoice.
Thank you for the 5 stars, Kara! It means so much to know you had a positive experience with our vet care team.💛 …

"One of the worst experiences I've ever had at a veterinary clinic. I took my dog ​​in with an aural hematoma and ear infection, and the vet refused to treat her because she was nervous, which I consider completely understandable in a dog in pain. After paying what seemed like an exorbitant amount for a consultation that didn't resolve the problem, we were sent home to return another day. I decided to seek a second opinion, and at another clinic, she was seen the same day without any issues. Amyra returned home stable and recovering. I left feeling like I had paid a lot for care that didn't address the reason we went there in the first place. Personally, I wouldn't return to or recommend this clinic."
Thank you to Gerardo for taking such good care of my dog. Thank you for getting her seen immediately for an emergency.
Sploot is the best vet Ive had.  Everyone there is super caring and knowledgeable.  Thank you so much to Gerardo S.  And the team there for always taking such great care of me and my pets.

They got us in super last minute for an eye infection right before we were leaving on a trip. They were not only attentive to the issue we came in for, but talked through some other health concerns we'd been having with our boy and gave us some information on potential next steps all around. They showed us how to apply the medication and made sure that we felt good about everything before we left. The front desk and doctors were all wonderful. We'll be switching over to this vet from the one around the corner from us! Highly recommend.
Loved the team and they show their importance in our pet’s health. Very patient and I love how they consult with you on treatments/exams and explain throughly.
Gerardo S was so kind to Sasha and took such good care of her. Thank you!!!

Sploot has been caring for my 2 dogs for a little over 2 years. They're very nice and easy to work with. I love their extended hours and urgent care availability.

They're not the cheapest but it seems like all veterinarians are expensive these days.  I paid $773 for annual exams and yearly vaccines for both dogs and a nail trim for one of them.

There was one time that they dispensed the wrong dose of heartworm medication and I didn't catch it until after I gave the medication.  Fortunately my dog was ok but it could have been really bad. We're all human,  mistakes can happen and they were very apologetic. My advice is to double check dosing before giving any medication.  That's a good thing to do regardless of where you get your medications.

I'm comfortable recommending Sploot to anyone looking for a veterinarian. Overall, they're good people that care about the animals they care for.
Thank you for the kind 5-star rating, Azra! Our vet care team is happy to be here for you and your beloved fur baby whenever you need us.💛 …
Gerardo gave my cat great care and made him feel very comfortable during our visit to get his vaccinations!  It was quick and easy for everyone.
Thanks Gerardo and team for taking such great care of cash.
Dr. Nguyen Than is the best. She was very gentle and handled my cat with care and was very informative on all my healthcare options
Gerardo S saw our cats Yogi and Tofu and he was so kind and communicative, as well as gentle with our kitties. Highly recommend!

Outstanding care! Indigo and Dr Cruz-Rincon were attentive, communicative, and very pet-focused with our cat, Alice. The result was a much calmer, healthier, Alice. Indigo even shared a photo from her time there!

I brought my little Havanese in a couple months ago for a medical emergency. They got me in right away. Gerardo made me and my pup Teddy feel comfortable and supported. He was very empathetic and gentle with my little guy. I appreciate all the support from the staff.

Had a great experience with annual vaccines for my lab mix Lucy. Gerardo S was so kind and gentle and was so quick with the shots, Lucy barely noticed! Thank you Dr. Than, Gerardo and Sploot Roscoe village! Highly recommend!
Dr. Cruz and the rest of the staff were very nice, they are all very patient and listened to all of my concerns. Thanks, Sploot!
What a great first experience with sploot today after an emergency visit today. Gerardo and the entire staff took such great care of my dog

Sploot Roscoe Village was phenomenal! The care and love for animals is very evident! Thank you Dr. Cruz and Sandy for taking care of my dog and showing her some much care and attention. I would highly recommend this clinic to any pet owner!
My vet of many years chose Sploot, so I did too.

So grateful for the team at Sploot! My cat was very sick and they were able to get her in the same day even though I had never been there before. Mayrn, Dr. Perkins, and Dr. Callan were the best! They were so caring, thorough in their exam and presenting options, and even called to check in the day after. Highly recommend!
Dr. Than and Nurse Taba were wonderful.  Taba was very friendly and helpful.  Dr.  Than was very thorough and had some great suggestions for helping my dog.

Excellent expertise, care, and professionalism!   We had kind team who cared for our senior cat. Terrific engagement and overall care for an urgent issue.  Costs were reasonable and helped us greatly.

Nobody at front desk or in lobby even after ringing the bell at 12:40pm. Was told they were on lunch and didn't hear the bell.

The Vet never read the notes from my previous Vet and had no idea why we were there.

Gave my Cat an antibiotic injection that had her lethargic and not eating for over 48 hrs, although she KNEW my cat just had major surgery a few weeks prior.

Got 3 different answers after asking was it normal that my cat had not returned to her normal self after 24 hrs and hadn't eaten in 48 hours.

Luckily my Cat threw up a lot of a yellow substance and after that, went back to drinking and eating.

It's in a mini mall with several other businesses so parking is horrendous.

If you're serious about your pet's health,  this is not the place to take them.

I had a great experience at Sploot Roscoe Village. They were gentle with Reggie and very informative with everything I need to know going forward. Gerardo was my intake nurse he was very friendly and so good with Reggie. Dr. Sarah Weinberg was amazing in explaining the step by step plan for Reggie at his appointment and future visits.
Gerardo S was efficient with Fluff and I
They take such good care of your babies and are so communicative, clear, and kind!

Hours of operation are not correct. Two days in a row they were closed by 6pm. Euthanasia cost was crazy, also tried to charge for an exam day of. Totally wrong to charge almost $60 for an exam same day as euthanasia as if it would change the outcome. They took that charge off but how many vulnerable people don’t notice a fee for a bogus exam. Also better to buy an urn from amazon than to pay over $500 for the whole process. Lots more choices for way less money
One more thing: tip for the vet techs, when a family’s loosing their furbabies don’t talk about how hard it is when their hearts stop immediately after the procedure. Not the time! As if our hearts weren’t already broken

Our dog is very anxious and the Sploot team was very understanding and accommodating to our boy! They also were really great at explaining everything they were doing for him and their recommendations. Mav got to leave with a belly full of treats and a tennis ball and wagged his tail the entire ride home!

Dr. Weinberg has provided exceptional care for my cats, and I am incredibly grateful for her knowledge, compassion, and dedication. She always takes the time to explain treatment options, answer questions, and ensure that I feel comfortable with every decision regarding my pets’ health.

Recently, one of my kittens went through a serious health issue, and Dr. Weinberg was thorough, responsive, and supportive throughout the entire process. Her guidance and attention to detail made a very stressful situation much easier to navigate. Thanks to her care, my kitten is now active, healthy, and thriving.

In addition to Dr. Weinberg’s outstanding care, everyone at the clinic has been incredibly kind, supportive, and professional. From the front desk staff to the veterinary technicians, every team member has treated my pets with genuine compassion and has always been willing to help whenever I had questions or concerns.

I never feel rushed during appointments, and it is clear that Dr. Weinberg and her entire team truly care about both their patients and their families. I highly recommend this clinic to anyone looking for knowledgeable, trustworthy, and compassionate veterinary care.
Gerardo was very helpful!

My minipoodle had a dental procedure here and it went really well. I get nervous about anything with anesthesia but they took amazing care of him and texted me with updates and photos. I felt so much more comfortable about the procedure and he’s doing great. I really appreciate the way they check-in during and after the procedure. It eases my anxiety as a dog mom 😭❤️ I highly recommend their services.
Everyone at Sploot was kind, caring and professional. They answered all my concerns and provided great care to my dog!

Taking a day off of work can be difficult in my situation. I love the flexible schedule Sploot offers that makes my life so much easier. I may not get the same doctor in every visit, but that’s not important to me. They’re all doctors at the end of the day who will take care of my cats. I don’t care if I’m assigned different ones as long as I can get in when I need to get in. I just want my cats to be healthy and live as long as they can possibly can. I’ve been bringing my two ragdolls to this location for two years now and we couldn’t be happier.

I did want to mention some negative reviews I came across that mentioned there was an experience of the business trying to oversell products/services. I just want to make it clear that during any of my visits since 2024 no individual has ever attempted to upsell any service to me except for to shave my sick cats fur around her rectum. I told them I struggled in cleaning her up and they offered to shave her. It made her and my life so much easier…

All the veterinary services in my areas have terrible hours of business. I’m an entrepreneur and taking a day off work in my field means missing out on cash and being inconvenient to my clients. That’s not how I do business. So, I’ll take all my cash to those who make themselves available and are ready to work. Not everyone works a 9-5. It’s not realistic to be closed on the weekends. Makes no sense. But, that’s why I spend hundreds of dollars at this place :). And I have no problem in doing so. Because, they keep my cats healthy when they need it most! ❤️
Sploot is great with my dog. They have a great plan for annual visits, etc Gerardo S was terrific
Everyone was so friendly and kind to my pup and I! They were clear in answering all of my questions and it was overall a great experience.
Third time visiting this location, and once again, the service I experienced was second to none. Dr.Tran and Taba took care of my orange goblin like he was one of their own.

We've been taking both of our dogs to Sploot for a few years. Both of them have their own anxieties about the vet and are always a handful, but the team never makes us feel like they're too much to deal with. Everyone we've ever talked to here cares a lot and takes the time to explain things to us and give us care options. Our dogs get great care there and we will continue to be customers!
Love this place! It’s so easy to get in quickly if you need or have an emergency. Staff is so friendly.
Very good experience!

Wonderful experience! I just got home with my 9 year old Golden Retriever who had a dental cleaning today. Really happy with the service, transparency, communication, and care. I don’t have pet insurance, so I really like the membership option for helping make it more affordable. First experience with the concierge medicine approach, and so far, it’s been great. Besides that, I really love all the staff at Roscoe Village. Very friendly and caring people!

I have taken my dog Q to this Sploot location 3 times now. Two for appointments, and one for triage. They have been very loving and caring each time, which I’m so grateful for, because it helps put my dog at ease. Also, they have been very reasonably priced, especially for the awesome care your pet receives.
Dr. Nyguen and Gerardo S. were both so helpful with my cats! They were so kind and took the time to answer all of my questions and give my cat the proper treatment.

We recently had to let our dog walk on to the next life. They were not only immensely patient but also understanding. They guided us through every step of the way, at our own pace, making sure those last moments were full of peace and love. As tough as it was, they assisted through it.
The team got me in for a same day appointment and spent well over 45 minutes talking with me and examining my dog. Everyone was so kind and helpful. I will definitely come back!
My senior dog had an alarming gastric problem and everyone was very calm and caring. She’s already feeling better.

The veterinarian and the assistant were both very kind and caring with Rocky during his visit. They took the time to answer all my questions and made us feel comfortable throughout the appointment. Thank you for the great care!

I brought my dog, Princess Diana, to Sploot one single time for an urgent care visit on a Sunday because our primary veterinarian was closed. She had just had surgery a few days earlier and developed what was very clearly a simple urinary tract infection. We were not seeking diagnostics, a workup, or a new primary vet — we needed antibiotics, period.
Despite explaining this clearly, Sploot immediately attempted to sell us nearly $1,000 worth of tests, including screening for cancer and kidney disease. This was wildly inappropriate given the circumstances and our clearly stated goal for the visit.
When we declined these unnecessary tests, the pressure did not stop. Three separate staff members were sent into the room to guilt us into paying for a more expensive and invasive urine collection method (a needle directly into her bladder) rather than allowing her to urinate into a cup outside. This was presented as a “cleaner sample,” even though:

We already knew she had a UTI
A sterile sample was not medically necessary to begin treatment
She was already in pain from recent surgery

After over an hour of repeated upselling and pressure, they finally tested the urine we collected ourselves, confirmed the obvious (she had a UTI), and prescribed antibiotics — which should have been the straightforward solution from the start.
Unfortunately, the issues didn’t end there.
Despite being explicitly told that we have a primary veterinarian and that this was a one-time urgent care visit, Sploot has spent the past year repeatedly emailing us reminders for routine blood work and exams — as if they were now our primary vet.
Most upsetting of all:
Even after I emailed them to inform them that Princess Diana has passed away and asked them to stop contacting me, the emails continue.
This experience made it painfully clear that Sploot prioritizes revenue over animal comfort and client boundaries. The hard-sell tactics, lack of respect for informed pet owners, and continued unwanted contact after a pet’s death are unacceptable.
I strongly recommend seeking urgent care elsewhere if you want a clinic that puts your pet’s best interests — not your wallet — first.
